doc.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006

title: Closing thanks and the need to record history
summary: They thank Rowe and stress the importance of recording this history, then say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That’s terrific. Well thanks to both of you for the important work you do. And it’s really uplifting to know that there’s support like this going on.

And thank you, and it’s uplifting to know that you’re doing what you’re doing as well because if we don’t get this history and don’t record it and get the history from the people like Phoebe that lived it, we have none.
Because there are no books about it yet. We didn’t write one.
Well Monk can write the book. He’ll write it.
All right. Thank you very much.
Thank you, thank you Tim. Thank you very much.
